step: Catalog-only (DECISIONS rows 239-240; Bambu import spec §K.1 D-1), after the Pricing V2 clean start (DECISIONS row 222): a product still waiting for its V2 price is SHOWN with no price — visible, unpriced, unsellable: its page and its public record answer 200 with price_status unpriced, a null price, and nothing that prices or sells it

unpriced_slug.note: workflow 7 reads one active, VISIBLE ordinary product that is not V2-published (read-only), after the deploy and right before the probes (a product published while the deploy ran is not mistaken for a leak), and passes --var unpriced_slug=…; once every product is published there is none and these probes skip with a notice

note: Anonymous GETs only. Before DECISIONS row 240 such a product was hidden (404); since catalog-only it is shown with «السعر غير متوفر حالياً» and no number: the page body is the catalog-only one (pricing, availability and initial_selection null, the product's price_iqd and display_price_iqd null), the public record says price.status unpriced with a null amount and no purchase block, and a search answer that shows it holds every price to the price rule. The cost and private keys stay forbidden on both. A product held for a catalogue gap (no picture, no section) stays hidden; the predicate's own tests gate that.
